// ============================================================

// ============================================================

export const CONFERENCE_DATE = new Date('2026-05-30T09:00:00');

export const SPEAKERS = [
  {
    id: 1,
    name: 'Mr. Val Okafor',
    title: 'CEO & Founder',
    organisation: 'The Val Okafor Company',
    session: 'Main Speaker',
    bio: "Val Okafor is a certified Human Capital Development Expert and globally recognised Youth Development Professional with over a decade of experience. As CEO of The Val Okafor Company, he pioneers leadership and entrepreneurship programs across Africa. A Nigerian Youth SDGs Champion, YALI Fellow, and Tony Elumelu Foundation mentor, he has represented Africa at the World Bank Group Youth Summit and beyond.",
    image: "/images/okafor.jpg", 
    initials: 'VO',
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    name: 'Azua Suurshater Stephen',
    title: 'CEO & Founder',
    organisation: 'Azua Photography',
    session: 'Keynote Speaker',
    bio: "Azua Suurshater Stephen is a professional photographer and 400-level Computer Science student at Godfrey Okoye University. Built on discipline, technology, and conviction, his creative practice led him to birth Build and Scale 2026 as Lead Convener. Anchored by scripture and a builder's mindset, he is living proof that you do not have to wait for the perfect moment.",
    image: "/images/azua.jpg",
    initials: 'AS',
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    name: 'Olaedo Unah',
    title: 'Visual Storyteller',
    organisation: 'GGG Media',
    session: 'Panelist',
    bio: "Olaedo Unah is a Law student, Associate Arbitrator with the Nigerian Institute of Chartered Arbitrators, and visual storyteller. She is the creative force behind GGG Media and founder of TheBlackNWhite, a platform simplifying legal concepts through video. She also produced the first documentary tour of GOUNI's campus, carving a distinctive path in law, education, and storytelling.",
    image: '/images/olaedo.jpeg',
    initials: 'OU',
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    name: 'Obi Ugochukwu Confidence',
    title: 'Community Builder & Public Voice',
    organisation: 'Godfrey Okoye University',
    session: 'Panelist',
    bio: "Obi Ugochukwu Confidence is a Computer Science student, athlete, and emerging public speaker from Abia State. Nicknamed 'Obi for President' by peers, he captained his football team to multiple victories and finished as GOUNI marathon runner-up. Rooted in philosophy and human communication, his bold voice continues to impact all who encounter him.",
    image: "/images/obi.jpeg",
    initials: 'OU',
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    name: 'Grace Omaka',
    title: 'Author', 
    organisation: "Theos' Grace",
    session: 'Panelist Moderator',
    bio: "Grace Omaka is an accounting undergraduate at Godfrey Okoye University, Lead Community Manager at TEDxEnugu, and author of Theos' Grace on Substack. She has shaped experiences for over 5,000 community members and contributed to GOUNI Press Crib for three years. A certified presenter trained by the West Africa Broadcast and Media Academy, she brings clarity and warmth to every room.",
    image: "/images/grace.jpeg",
    initials: 'GO',
  },
  {
    id: 6, 
    name: 'Praise Godwill',
    title: 'Author of Two Days to Christmas',
    organisation: 'Godfrey Okoye University',
    session: 'Panelist',
    bio: "Praise Godwill is a creative writer, faith-driven communicator, and author of Two Days to Christmas. She runs a growing email community centred on life and faith, and has a strong track record in youth development, from leading a Junior Achievement Nigeria club to hosting spelling bees and career sessions across the FCT. She also composes and sings.",
    image: "/images/praise.jpeg",
    initials: 'OO',
  },
  {
    id: 7, 
    name: 'Matthew Francisca Kyak',
    title: "Founder",
    organisation: "Kyak's Treats",
    session: 'Panelist',
    bio: "Matthew Francisca Kyak is a Nigerian entrepreneur, model, and emerging trainer from Taraba State. A graduate of International Relations from GOUNI, she was Miss Godfrey Okoye University 2022 and Top Female Model 2023. She is the founder of Kyak's Treats and a STEP S Trainer, committed to entrepreneurship, community building, and empowering others through resilience and purpose.",
    image: "/images/Francisca.PNG",
    initials: 'OO',
  },
  {
    id: 8,  
    name: 'Nwankwo Chiamaka Vera',
    title: 'Founder',
    organisation: 'VEEJSTORE',
    session: 'Keynote Speaker',
    bio: "Nwankwo Chiamaka Vera is a 400-level Law student at ESUT and founder of VEEJSTORE, a brand specialising in gift items and jewellery. Established three years ago, the brand recently launched its first physical store. Building without prior mentorship, Vera combines legal education with entrepreneurship, with a long-term goal of becoming a business lawyer and inspiring others to create real opportunities.",
    image: "/images/Vera.PNG",
    initials: 'NCV',
  },  
  {
    id: 9,  
    name: 'Victoria Kyocher Ivveren',
    title: 'CEO & Founder',
    organisation: 'Bloomzs Stitches',
    session: 'Keynote Speaker',
    bio: "Victoria Kyocher Ivveren is CEO of Bloomzs Stitches, an Abuja-based fashion brand blending elegance, innovation, and cultural expression. A Benue State University graduate with seven years of experience, she has transformed creativity into a thriving brand. Beyond design, she is a respected mentor to aspiring designers and young professionals, leading with intention and inspiring others to pursue excellence.",
    image: "/images/Victoria.jpeg",
    initials: 'VKI',
  }, 
  {
    id: 10,  
    name: 'Thompson Okoro',
    title: 'Model & Media Personality',
    organisation: 'Godfrey Okoye University',
    session: 'Keynote Speaker',
    bio: "Thompson is a media personality, broadcaster, model, actor, and communicator passionate about storytelling, and entertainment. An OAP at Gouni Radio, he blends media, fashion, public speaking, and creative expression to inspire, entertain, and create impact",
    image: "/images/thompson.jpeg",
    initials: 'TO',
  }, 
  {
    id: 11,  
    name: 'Kelechi Eze',
    title: 'Purpose-Driven Content Creator & Digital Voice',
    organisation: 'Godfrey Okoye University',
    session: 'Keynote Speaker',
    bio: "Kelechi Drive is a final-year Economics student at GOUNI and digital content creator on a mission to challenge mediocrity locally and globally. Through his content and community, he drives people toward purpose and their full potential. His message is clear: placing Jesus at the centre of your pursuits is foundational, and you alone hold the power to change your trajectory.",
    image: "/images/kelechi.jpeg", 
    initials: 'KE',
  },
  {
    id: 12,  
    name: 'Favour Ogechukwu Egbogu ',
    title: 'Legal Advocate & Commanding Public Voice',
    organisation: 'Godfrey Okoye University',
    session: 'Keynote Speaker',
    bio: "Favour Ogechukwu Egbogu is a 400-level Law student at GOUNI, Senior Advocate of GOUNI LAWSA, and General Secretary of the pioneer Students Bar Association. An international public speaking champion and Best Speaker at Let's Speak Women Open 2025, she hosts and debates with equal conviction. She joins us today as conference host, proof that your voice is your greatest asset.",
    image: "/images/favour.jpeg",
    initials: 'FOE',
  }, 
];

export const PROGRAMME = [
  { time: '8:00 AM', title: 'Registration & Welcome', desc: 'Attendees arrive, register, and receive conference materials. Networking begins.', type: 'logistics' },
  { time: '9:00 AM', title: 'Opening Ceremony', desc: 'Welcome address, institutional remarks, and setting the tone for the day.', type: 'ceremony' },
  { time: '9:30 AM', title: 'Keynote Address I', desc: 'Opening keynote: a real story of going from idea to impact.', type: 'keynote' },
  { time: '10:30 AM', title: 'Workshop Session I: Build', desc: 'Hands on session on foundations: idea validation, structure, and systems.', type: 'workshop' },
  { time: '12:00 PM', title: 'Keynote Address II', desc: 'High energy midday keynote on discipline, execution, and personal responsibility.', type: 'keynote' },
  { time: '1:00 PM', title: 'Lunch Break & Networking', desc: 'Structured lunch break with peer networking and informal conversations with speakers.', type: 'break' },
  { time: '2:00 PM', title: 'Workshop Session II: Scale', desc: 'Practical session on growth, sustainability, and taking initiatives beyond the classroom.', type: 'workshop' },
  { time: '3:30 PM', title: 'Panel Discussion', desc: 'Experienced builders answer audience questions on real challenges in building and scaling.', type: 'panel' },
  { time: '4:30 PM', title: 'Closing Keynote & Call to Action', desc: 'Final address challenging every attendee to leave and build. Not tomorrow, but now.', type: 'keynote' },
  { time: '5:00 PM', title: 'Awards, Certificates & Close', desc: 'Recognition of participants, certificate distribution, and official close of conference.', type: 'ceremony' },
];

export const FAQS = [
  {
    question: 'Is the conference free to attend?',
    answer: 'Yes. Build & Scale 2026 is completely free for all registered attendees. All you need to do is register your seat in advance to secure your place, as spaces are limited.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Who can attend Build & Scale 2026?',
    answer: 'The conference is open to university students (100 to 400 Level), senior secondary school students, and aspiring entrepreneurs or innovators. If you have a dream you want to build on, this conference is for you.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Where exactly is the venue?',
    answer: 'The conference will be held at the Peter Mbah Law Auditorium, Godfrey Okoye University, Enugu. Registration opens at 8:00 AM on Saturday, 30th May 2026.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Will certificates be issued?',
    answer: 'Yes. All registered attendees who are present at the conference will receive a certificate of participation at the close of the event.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Can students from other universities attend?',
    answer: 'Absolutely. Build & Scale 2026 is not limited to Godfrey Okoye University students. Students from any institution in Enugu and beyond are welcome to register and attend.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Will there be refreshments on the day?',
    answer: 'Yes. Light refreshments will be provided during the lunch break and at designated snack breaks throughout the day.',
  },
  {
    question: 'How do I confirm my registration?',
    answer: 'Once you submit your registration form, you will receive a confirmation message. Please keep this safe, as you may be asked to present it at the check-in desk on event day.',
  },
  {
    question: 'What should I bring on the day?',
    answer: 'Come with an open mind, a notebook, and something to write with. If you have a business idea or project you are working on, feel free to bring notes. The workshops are practical and interactive.',
  },
];

export const STATS = [
  { value: 100, suffix: '+', label: 'Expected Attendees' },
  { value: 1, suffix: '', label: 'Day of Impact' },
  { value: 8, suffix: '+', label: 'Expert Speakers' },
  { value: 4, suffix: '', label: 'Sessions' },
];
